title: Automated commit git identity
author: author-a
description: Day 1 records the git user.name that every scripted/automated commit to this project's internal docs repo must use, kept distinct from any human developer's own identity. The name is an arbitrary made-up token with no natural-language content, so a memory-less model has no way to reconstruct it from the day-N prompt or from general conventions about bot commit identities.
day1_prompt: Day 1: we are wiring up automated commits for this project's internal docs repo. Decide and record the convention: every scripted commit must use the git user.name 'Atlas-Auto' — kept distinct from any human developer's own git identity.
memory_sentence: This project's scripted/automated commits use the git user.name 'Atlas-Auto'.
canon_heading: Automated commits use the git user.name Atlas-Auto
day_n_prompt: Day 6: a teammate is writing a script that will commit to the docs repo and asks what git user.name our automation must commit under. Answer with only the user.name value.
